noEntries: No entries yet. They will come with the next stage.
rmLead: Every system and feature in one place: what is done and when, what is in progress and what is planned. Dates are set only by the team — where there are none, it says so.
rmDesc: All AIVERSE engine systems and their features: done, in progress and planned.
docsLead: Guides and system references from the repository. Pages are built from docs/ on every site publication, so they match the code in main.
docsLangNoteRu: This document is maintained in Russian.
relLead: Every release is a tag in the repository plus ready-to-run editor and tool builds for Windows and macOS. Below is what went into each version and what is already done for the next one.
relBuildsBranch: All builds on the builds branch
relDlNone: The builds branch no longer keeps packages of this version — build it from the tag.
relNextLead: Devlog stages after {v} ({d}). They are in progress or in main but not tagged yet.
relNextEmpty: No new devlog entries since the last release.
relNextAll: All {n} entries are in the devlog →
relOtherLead: Builds on the builds branch without a release: the version and the commit they were built from.
verNextTitle: Already in main, ships in release {v}
verBranchTitle: On a separate branch, ships after it is merged into main
incRuOnly: This article is in Russian only for now.
blogLead: Every stage of {s} with screenshots, what was verified and what was not yet.
blogHubLead: Everything happening in the engine beyond the systems on the main page: the editor, builds, networking, gameplay, MCP tooling.
lnLead: Each line is a system, stations are items of its plan. Click a line for the detailed roadmap.
docsTranslated: Translated. The original may be newer: source document.
catLead: Materials, textures, project templates and other content that is not part of the engine. Download what you need or add it to a project with one command.
catHowLead: A package is copied into the project folder; its version and file hashes go to aiverse.lock. Downloads are kept once per computer.
catAddLead: Anyone can offer a package: a pull request to the catalog repository, reviewed by the owner. After the merge it appears here and in the engine by itself.

catJs.error: Could not load the catalog. The package list is in index.json of the catalog repository.

galLead: Every engine frame that appeared during development, newest first. Click a frame to open it large, or its caption to read the entry.
catAddSteps: Write aiverse.package.json: English title and summary, translations as title-ru, summary-de…, licence, minEngine, install.mount.
Add README.md and a preview.jpg (a real engine frame or the asset itself).

Put the files into files/, up to 2 GB. The owner accepts the pull request with the label accept: the files become a release archive and never enter the repository history. Textures of another package are not copied: depend on it.
Run python3 tools/catalog.py check (0 errors) and open a pull request.
